sequences.description: I1 attack: Cross-source trust confusion. Create two SAML providers/sources intended to represent different upstream IdPs/realms, then attempt to authenticate to source A while claiming realm/provider metadata for source B (or vice versa). If authentik applies verification policy for one source but consumes proof under another, attacker-signed assertions may be accepted.
sequences.invariant_hypothesis: I1: Verification policy must be bound to the exact SAML Source/realm context. A forged assertion must not be accepted due to cross-source trust-anchor confusion (verifying under source B but consuming under source A).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Expected secure behavior: forged attacker-signed assertion must be rejected; cross-realm/provider metadata must not cause verification under the wrong trust policy.
